005package org.wpilib.romi;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice.Direction;
009import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDouble;
010import org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorController;
011
012/**
013 * RomiMotor.
014 *
015 * <p>A SimDevice based motor controller representing the motors on a Romi robot
016 */
017public class RomiMotor implements MotorController {
018  private final SimDouble m_simSpeed;
019  private boolean m_inverted;
020
021  /**
022   * Constructor.
023   *
024   * @param channel The PWM channel that the RomiMotor is attached to. 0 is the left motor, 1 is the
025   *     right.
026   */
027  public RomiMotor(int channel) {
028    OnBoardIO.allocatePWM(channel);
029
030    // We want this to appear on the WS messages as type: "PWM", device: <channel>
031    String simDeviceName = "PWM:" + channel;
032    SimDevice romiMotorSimDevice = SimDevice.create(simDeviceName);
033
034    if (romiMotorSimDevice != null) {
035      romiMotorSimDevice.createBoolean("init", Direction.OUTPUT, true);
036      m_simSpeed = romiMotorSimDevice.createDouble("speed", Direction.OUTPUT, 0.0);
037    } else {
038      m_simSpeed = null;
039    }
040  }
041
042  @Override
043  public void setThrottle(double throttle) {
044    if (m_simSpeed != null) {
045      m_simSpeed.set(m_inverted ? -throttle : throttle);
046    }
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  public double getThrottle() {
051    if (m_simSpeed != null) {
052      return m_simSpeed.get();
053    }
054
055    return 0.0;
056  }
057
058  @Override
059  public void setInverted(boolean isInverted) {
060    m_inverted = isInverted;
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  public boolean getInverted() {
065    return m_inverted;
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  public void disable() {
070    setThrottle(0.0);
071  }
072}
